title: Themes
description: DataViews grid + table view of installed themes. Reads via `core-data` `'root','theme'` entity.

variant.description: Optional DataView variant id. v2 back-compat: when the v3 compiler synthesizes a screen from a v2 route, `config.variant` flows into `dataViewVariant` and reaches `settings.dataViews.root.theme.<variant>`.

documentation.purpose: DataViews host over the `root/theme` entity. Default grid layout shows screenshot + name + status + truncated description; table layout offers sortable columns for power users. The Activate action (eligible only when status=inactive) calls the shell's custom `/wp-admin-shell/v1/activate-theme` endpoint with a wp-admin fallback. The Details action opens a modal with full description + version + author + theme-site link.

reads.purpose: Resolved DataView doc — fields, default view, default layouts, actions. Read via `useDataView(screenId)`; baseline ships in `app.json#dataView` and is injected post-merge by `inject_app_baselines`.
Fallback for active stylesheet lookup before core-data hydrates.

writes.purpose: Switch the active theme via the shell's custom endpoint.

states.renders: DataViews built-in loading indicator over an empty grid.
Grid layout with screenshot tiles; status='active' floats first via the default sort by status asc. Activate action surfaces as an icon button on non-active rows; Details opens a modal.

states.when: User clicked Details on a row
states.renders: DataViews RenderModal with large screenshot + full description + version / author + Theme site / Activate buttons.

interactions.effect: POST `/wp-admin-shell/v1/activate-theme` with `{ stylesheet }`; on success invalidate `root/theme`. On failure: `window.location.href` to `themes.php?action=activate&stylesheet=...` so the user falls back to wp-admin.
Open the details modal with that theme's metadata + inline Activate button + Theme site link.

a11y.focus-management: DataViews owns focus inside the grid + modal. The RenderModal contract restores focus to the action trigger on close.

constraints.note: WordPress core REST does not expose a theme-switch operation. The shell ships a custom `/wp-admin-shell/v1/activate-theme` endpoint; rebuilds must provide the equivalent or implement the wp-admin link fall-back.

If the custom endpoint 404s (older shell version or stripped feature), the app navigates to wp-admin's `themes.php` flow so the user can complete the action — preserves the right outcome even without the optimized path.

design-system-leakage.purpose: DataViews + DataForm components, field descriptor shape. Grid + table view with filtering, sorting, pagination, selection, per-row + bulk actions, action modals.
Details modal layout and action buttons.
Activate action icon (registered in the core-default engine icon table).
